Example IdealAdaptorStanfitInput and IdealAdaptorStaninput objects

Source: R/S7-example-objects.R
example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input.Rd

Constructs example IdealAdaptorStanfitInput and IdealAdaptorStaninput objects from data generated by example_exposure_test_data.

Usage

example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input(
  model_family = c("NIW", "NIX", "MNIX"),
  n_cues = NULL,
  categories = c("/d/", "/t/"),
  control = control_staninput(),
  data = NULL,
  ...
)

example_ideal_adaptor_staninput(
  model_family = c("NIW", "NIX", "MNIX"),
  n_cues = NULL,
  categories = c("/d/", "/t/"),
  stanmodel = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

model_family

Character string indicating the model family: "NIW" (default), "NIX", or "MNIX".

n_cues

Integer number of acoustic cues (1 or 2). Default: 1 (or 2 for "MNIX").

categories

Character vector of length 2 naming the categories. Default: c("/d/", "/t/").

control

Named list of Stan input control parameters created by control_staninput. Default: control_staninput().

data

Optional list of exposure and test tibbles as returned by example_exposure_test_data. If NULL (default), data are generated via example_exposure_test_data.

...

Additional arguments passed to example_exposure_test_data when data is NULL.

stanmodel

Optional character string naming the Stan model for example_ideal_adaptor_staninput. Defaults to "MNIX_ideal_adaptor_ideal_integrator" when model_family == "MNIX" and "<model_family>_ideal_adaptor" otherwise.

Value

For example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input, an object of class IdealAdaptorStanfitInput. For example_ideal_adaptor_staninput, an object of class IdealAdaptorStaninput.

Details

example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input constructs the complete high-level IdealAdaptorStanfitInput object (including data, transform information, and metadata). example_ideal_adaptor_staninput creates a typed Stan-ready input (IdealAdaptorStaninput) via .new_staninput().

See also

example_exposure_test_data, new_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input

Examples

# Generate Stanfit input from small synthetic data
stan_input <- example_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input(
  model_family = "NIX",
  n_cues = 1,
  n_exposure_per_category = 5L,
  n_test_steps_category = 3L,
  n_test_steps_adaptation = 2L,
  n_test_tokens_per_location = 5L
)
stan_input
#> <IdealAdaptorStanfitInput>
#>   Categories (2): /d/, /t/
#>   Cues (1): VOT
#>   Groups (3): no_exposure, left_shifted, right_shifted
#>   Data: 95 rows
